notes.title: 6 more languages! - Update 0.9.4
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37145478/401ca242f62cbf91cc636ed09605bf763819590c.jpg
Hello Chefs!
...or should we say: olá, hallo, bonjour, ciao, selam, and hola! We thought that before we could serve the main course – Let's Cook Together 1.0 – you should first try this huge side dish: the Language Lasagna! (that's because the languages are literally stacked on each other 🥞)

Let's Cook Together is now playable in 8 languages:

English
Polish
Spanish
German
French
Italian
Turkish
Portuguese


With this update, we've added six of them, and we would have never done it without the help of our wonderful community! Thank you once again for allowing so many new players around the world to cook together (especially you, Murat!) 💛💛💛

OK, but where can I find this great community you're talking about?
Great question with a simple answer! Just join our 👾 Discord server here: https://discord.gg/qaZNUmK. Say hi (or hola, or whatever you like!), have a friendly chat with us, and find people to play our games with. Piece of cake, really (and the taste is great)!

That photo – is that you, guys?
Yes! From left: Maciek, sketching tasty foods 24/7, Maciej, who can split himself into pieces and reside on Facebook. Twitter, and Discord simultaneously, Miłosz, often so busy fighting the Bugs of Bad Taste and porting Let's Cook Together to other consoles he forgets to eat, Karolina, in charge of the e-mail inbox, receiving and sending messages about as often as Maciek sketches food, and Jan & Lucy, the creators, the basic, fundamental ingredients of our team, and the guys you know from previous updates. Nice to meet you!

What's next?
The release of Let's Cook Together 1.0. We're going bananas over this, so we'll just leave you with some of them: 🍌🍌🍌🍌🍌

Full list of changes:

 food is now twisting a little bit mid-air after you throw it;
 when two new dishes are unlocked, the cookbook now opens on the first one instead of the last;
 closing the game after changing the profile no more causes the progress to be lost;
 fixed stuttering loading screens;
 fixed a bug where it was impossible to finish the tutorial after serving the burger too fast;
 squashed a few typos.


Cook safe!
Yellow Dot Games Team 🟡

notes.title: Endless Mode is here - Update 0.9.3
notes.notes:
Hello Chefs!
We've been endlessly working on this big update – and there's a good reason for that. Firstly, we've been polishing the game to make the release smooth as butter. Secondly, we're proud to finally introduce Its Infiniteness:

Endless Mode!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37145478/d01592e654934ee28ff7d00f45ce06b4efb015f4.jpg
Cooking is eternal, so don't get tired of it! In Endless mode, you can push your cooperation skills to the limit. The orders keep coming one after another, and if you miss any of them or drop any ingredient on the floor – poof, it's over! Keep focused and earn as many coins as you can. Let us know how you did on our Discord server: https://discord.gg/HXg8qjy

Careful with that!
If the danger of missing an order in the Endless mode wasn't enough, we've also added a new idle animation. Danger: it involves sharp objects 🔪
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37145478/562548e7258e07f8bbe4b3413f31c8ae4699018e.gif

What's next?
Let's Cook Together is almost ready to leave Early Access. Before that happens, we want to translate our tasty experience into as many languages as possible, so that everybody can understand just how mouth-wateringly good it is. So if you speak French, Italian, Spanish, or Portuguese and have made it this far into the update note, perhaps you could also reach us at contact@yellow-dot.eu and help us with the translation. Tasty thanks!

Full list of changes:

 introduced the Endless mode
 added a new idle animation to our chefs
 added a clear Remote Play Together instruction (available from the main menu)
 added a new separate endless achievement for each season
 rewrote the scripts for the Season 1 frying pan. The code in there was one of the first ones to be written (almost 3 years ago!). While it worked it produced a bug that sometimes caused your fried meat to turn into raw meat (and vice-versa) when put away on a universal tray. This bug should no longer occur
 when exiting the summary scene after playing a Battle game the navigation will now be focused on the proper level button
 added small gallery indicators to better visualize all gallery views (eg. in the episode selection)
 redesigned the tandoor oven (Season 3) graphics for the Battle mode
 fixed a bug that would cause the coin particles to not reach their destination properly (eg. in the summary screen)
 fixed inconsistency in the achievements list which could occur after deleting a profile
 updated the game to the newest stable version of the Unity Engine. This will hopefully get rid of some rare bugs and possibly introduce some new ones :-)
 professional proofreading for English (thanks Karolina) and Polish (thanks Lena) localization was done
 fixed a bug that would sometimes prevent the achievement to show up for some time
 fixed layers in Burger Ring (Season 1) and Pancake Splash (Season 2). The metal tables below the frying pans and deep fryers should now be visible
 fixed a bug in Season 3 levels config which caused the tomatoes to be unlocked too soon in the Episodes campaign
 fixed a bug that would sometimes cause the Orange Gina glass to show on top of the drinks dispenser head
 fixed a bug that would on rare occasions cause ingredients put on a universal tray to disappear


Cook safe!
Lucy & Jan Mysior
Yellow Dot Games Team

notes.title: Edd & Achievements - Update 0.9.2
notes.notes:
Hello Chefs!
For this week's update, we have prepared quite a lot of changes.

Edd
Our final planned playable character Edd the Mushroom (Occupation: Trip advisor) is now available in-game. Enjoy!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37145478/1a266264950e5fbe48c9a5e7dc55e6bddc166729.jpg

Achievements
Another super-big feature is the achievements system. Paweł, one of our awesome gameplay consultants who is also a certified achievements freak, designed 39 achievements, Bartek designed the icons and I've put it all together into the game and integrated with Steam.
We have a separate list of achievements in-game that looks like this:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37145478/8d80982862e47ec1308c8674c6021cb27989891c.png

Let us know what you think of our achievements. Are they too easy ːsteamboredː or too hard ːsteammockingː to obtain? 

Other changes:

 changed the size of images presented during the level start (new ingredient, new appliance, new dish, etc) so that they are sharp (some of them were upscaled before and appeared blurry). Thanks to Maciej, our awesome community manager for pointing that out and being persistent :-)
 changed the sprites used in the order cards so that they are crisper (again thanks to Maciek for pointing out their blurriness)
 changed the names of difficulty levels to make them more intuitive
 fixed a bug that sometimes caused serving a dish to subtract time from an order card instead of adding it
 fixed a bug that caused some particle effects to render as pink rectangles when ending a level
 renamed the button in the summary screen from "Next episode" to "Continue" to avoid confusion (thanks to Karolina for the suggestion)
 Lucy tweaked the level configuration for Season 3 to make it more balanced
 change the sprite for Naan (Season 3) to make it crisper
 tweaked the animation for order cards spawning (the underneath plate no longer spawns first)
 fixed a bug that caused the cookbook to show only the first few recipes in the Battle mode
 added the sound for plate jumping and disappearing when completing an order
 added the sound for when entering the upgrades shop from within the Battle mode scene
 squashed a few typos


What's Next?
Endless mode is the last big feature we plan to incorporate into Let's Cook Together. If everything goes smoothly, it should be live within the next week.
Other planned updates:

 Language support for French, Italian, German, Spanish, and Portuguese. Support for other languages is under consideration - if you would like to see the game in your language and/or would like to contribute, contact us via the discussion board, via Discord or reach to us at contact@yellow-dot.eu
 Better and more clear information on how to play the game remotely
 Other small features and bugfixes


We love working on players' insights and improving the game with you all, so please do not hesitate to reach us on the discussion boards or our Discord.

Cook safe!
Lucy & Jan Mysior
Yellow Dot Games

notes.title: Battle Mode - Update 0.9.1
notes.notes:
Hello Chefs!  
Today's update is a big one. The Battle mode i.e. player vs player is now live!
Be advised!: while this mode will (probably) not break your relationship, it has proven to cause some resentment and silent treatment. Play at your own risk :-)

As always, we wouldn't be ourselves if we didn't run some sort of game-related "research". Below is the footage of our battle mode research with one of my favorite music tracks - Season 3 battle mode music:
[previewyoutube=kdap3msXKqM;full][/previewyoutube]

Season 3 changes
Basing on feedback from our testers and players we have changed quite a lot of Season 3 gameplay:

 Bartek, our awsome graphics designer, changed many sprites. Things should now stand out more clearly and the dishes should be a bit more intuitive and easy to remember (still super-hard tho so be on your guard!)
 Lucy completely redesigned the levels so that the new dish progression is a little slower but more diverse at the same time
 We have removed two dishes as they created some confusion. This should make things just a little easier too


The above changes were mostly inspired by feedback from our awesome marketing team: Karolina & Maciej. Thanks guys!
Please let us know what you think of how Ticassa Masalassa (Season 3) plays out now.

Other changes

 Redesigned the UI of the order cards a bit. Some testing pairs had trouble understanding what needed to be served and what was served already. To address this we have completely hidden the plate with served dishes behind the order card. This allowed us to reshape the card and the progress bar a little bit. We've sacrificed a tiny fraction of immersion for a noticeable clarity boost. Thanks to all our friends who had the courage to play-test in front of us and inspired us - most notably Emilka & Marek and Ania & Kuba! Here you can see these changes visualized:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37145478/2763345f59672641b1272dbf268f6d0aa9015ad6.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37145478/702decbbbd2bf00b4f6b3b125ee436d4862d8458.png

 Redesigned the sound system to (hopefully) combat problems with some sounds not playing
 Added a stinking cloud effect (designed by awesome Kjell) whenever you throw something into the trash bin. Some play-testers did not know it's bad to waste food :-)
 Adjusted activation areas for some ingredients in Season 3 - Gloria had trouble activating some of them and now she doesn't
 Fixed a bug that would break the view of the summary screen when you had a negative coin score on a level (this is why kids make such good testers - they do things an adult would never think of!)
 Fixed the margins of some labels in the summary scene
 Made the blender in Season 1 a bit quieter
 The first level of each season was renamed to "Pilot Episode"
 Fixed some improper layering bugs in a couple of scenes
 Squashed some typos in the Polish localization files
 Leonard now gives a proper comment when trying to blend an "unblendable" ingredient
 Added a small outline animation to the number of purchasable upgrades indicator in the summary screen to make it more noticeable
 Added a similar outline in the upgrades shop to make the currently affordable upgrades stand out
 Improved the layout of the bottom buttons in the summary screen
 Fixed a bug that would sometimes cause all menu buttons to lose highlight
 Fixed a couple of cookbook recipes


What's Next?  
The battle mode is another important milestone in making the game how we wanted it to be. It adds completely new experiences and meta-mechanics, improving the replayability by a lot. 
What we plan to do next (in the probable order):
[olist]
 Edd - the final planned playable character.
 Endless mode.
 Steam achievements support.
 Language support for French, Italian, German, Spanish, and Portuguese. Support for other languages is under consideration
 Better and more clear information on how to play the game remotely.
 Other features and bugfixes.
[/olist]
We love working on players' insights and improving the game with you all, so please do not hesitate to reach us on the discussion boards or our Discord.

Cook safe!
Lucy & Jan Mysior
Yellow Dot Games

notes.title: Ticassa Masalassa Season 3 - Update 0.9.0
notes.notes:
Hello Chefs!  
The day has come!
After many, many days (and nights) of development and testing, Season 3 named "Ticassa Masalassa" is finally here! We are so happy to be able to give it to you.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37145478/ad3a8dfe97cf6afead92942a4dffee2840cca1c1.png

Characters (from the left): Jan - Lead Developer. Kuba - Tester, Chad - Primate Caretaker, Gloria - French Teacher, Adam - Tester, Mati - Hardcore QA Tester, Lucy - Gameplay Designer

BE ADVISED! Season 3 is... very hard. Be prepared to look up recipes in the cookbook constantly. New gameplay mechanisms also require you to squeeze the last drops of your coop skills even more than before. We love playing it and we hope you will love it too.

An important new feature is the ability to reassign keyboard keys. This is the single most requested feature (especially from owners of laptops that do not have the "Right Ctrl" key). It surprisingly took a lot of work to implement it, as we had to redesign how buttons are shown on-screen. We previously just selected an appropriate sprite to show a button, which was easy. Now we use a mixture of sprites (for gamepad buttons) and dynamically generated text (for keyboard buttons).
WARNING! The default keys for the right player on the keyboard were changed. Serving will now by default be done via the slash key "/" (which on the majority of keyboards is next to the right shift). If your keyboard has the right ctrl and you prefer the old layout, please reassign the serving key in the settings menu.

Here are all the other changes:

 The result of another one of the brilliant ideas our internal tester Michał T. In short - you will now be able to much more easily tell which ingredients were added into the mixing bowl (Season 1) and shake maker (Season 2). Check out this screen:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37145478/cad79151ba82043bf88dd201705e94b0935464e2.png
 After the tutorial level is finished, Leonard will now give a short explanation on where coins come from in the game.
 You can now see the total number of stars in a season on the level summary screen. Stars will also be added there dynamically (like coins already did).
 The number of orders counter is now updated sooner after an order is completed.
 You will now see newly unlocked chef or game mode (once battle and endless modes come online) on the level summary screen.
 In the profiles screen when deleting a profile the currently active profile will remain selected.
 Made the shake maker sound a little louder.
 Fixed some polish fonts bugs.


What's Next?  
Season 3 marks a very significant milestone in the development roadmap. What we plan to do next (in the probable order):
[olist]
 Versus mode. We have playtested it already and should ship it really soon. On the side note - I have never seen my wife so aggressive (unfortunately I kept winning :-)
 Edd - the final planned playable character.
 Endless mode.
 Steam achievements support.
 Language support for French, Italian, German, Spanish, and Portuguese. Support for other languages is under consideration
 Better and more clear information on how to play the game remotely.
 Other features and bugfixes.
[/olist]

Many of the features we introduced over the last months come directly from the ideas brought to us by you - the players. We are very open to these ideas and love working on them, so please do not hesitate to reach us on the discussion boards or our Discord.

Cook safe!
Lucy & Jan Mysior
Yellow Dot Games

notes.title: Chelsea & Happy dancing - Update 0.8.7
notes.notes:
Hello Chefs!
Season 3 is very advanced in development and we've started to test it internally (boy is it difficult). In the meantime, to ease the pain of waiting, I've managed to finish up some other tasks from our roadmap to bring you some freshness. Chelsea - our 5th character now enters the competition and she is... hot, hot, hot!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37145478/32bde2bf9f5bffa0e585ed4ad3df991bfbd90aeb.jpg

In the above picture:
On the left: Chelsea - Professional Lipstick Tester, Hot Pepper
On the right: Lucy - Gameplay Designer, Hot Female (and my wife!)

Also, our characters are now animated in some parts of the menu, which is especially significant in the level summary screen. Here is a video of Gloria and Suzie doing the three-stars-happy-dance. We strongly encourage you to dance with them:

[previewyoutube=y9qJ6aHR3pc;full][/previewyoutube]

Here are all the changes:
 In the post-level summary the characters will now perform a happy-dance to a new music track if you manage to get three stars.
 There are also some nice fireworks effects made by Kjell during the happy dance.
 We know the players like to scout out "Who has what ingredient/appliance" before the level starts. We do that too! To make that even easier you can now hide the cookbook after the new stuff presentation but before the level start.
 The particle effect for food joining and more notably the trail of thrown food have been refreshed and are now colored differently for each thrown ingredient/dish.
 During the chef selection the characters are now also animated.
 When adding milk into the dough machine (Season 2) you can now see the remaining milk capacity. Thanks to Michał T. - one of our testing friends for suggesting the idea.
 The topping machine (Season 2) now fires new chocolate and sprinkles particles (made by Kjell).
 The shadows cast by counters and ingredient tables are more realistic.
 Chefs should no longer switch sides when using blender after coming from the opposite side.
 Fixed a bug that occurred when activating blender while operating it.
 Smashing buttons during the loading screen should no longer break the level start sequence (this FUBAR was fixed once before but apparently reappeared). 
 Some level user interface elements were shown on top of the pause menu content. This is no longer true.


This game version now uses the codebase from the "Season 3" branch. This means that:
A. We are really close to releasing Season 3.
B. New bugs may appear in Seasons 1 and 2.

As always - we are open to all suggestions. If you feel something is missing in Let's Cook Together, please reach out to us on the discussion board or on Discord.

Cook safe!
Lucy & Jan Mysior
Yellow Dot Games

notes.title: Understanding income - Update 0.8.6
notes.notes:
Hello Chefs!
This week's update is all about giving the players more information on where their coins come from. Our (awesome) beta-tester Michał T. inspired us to it with his feedback - Thanks Michał!
You can see here how Lucy and I discuss the new summary screen at our anti-covid-work-station / happy place:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37145478/5660edf98057dcc164f6c4b223343e8523d8f5de.jpg

Anyway here are the changes:

 New and more informative order summary. You can now see how much coins you earn for each dish and how much you earn from tips and combo bonuses. See this video to see what that's about: 
[previewyoutube=iZTKpXa81-c;full][/previewyoutube]
 Completely new post-level summary. This not only gives more info on income sources but is clearer. This new layout also makes place for chef win/lose reactions - which is something Marcin (our graphics designer) has been working hard on for the past two weeks. There will be a very nice surprise in there as well in one of the next updates.
 Preview of Season 3 - Ticassa Masalassa in restaurant choice. For now, it has the "coming soon" ribbon, but it's in the works (the tandoor oven mechanics are going to be LE-GEN-DA-RY!).
 When you burn food the negative coin value is applied immediately (before it was applied when you threw the burned food into the trash).
 When trying to purchase an upgrade for a maxed-out appliance (in the upgrades shop) the stars shake animation is no longer played.
 Lucy extended the number of dishes to serve in the last level of Pancake Splash significantly.
 Added left and right arrows in the UI of the restaurant choice view in the menu.
 When repeating the level for a lower star score, the number of stars will now show up properly in the menu.
 Fixed a bug (FINALLY!) which broke some sounds or music when restarting a level.
 Lowered the upgrade costs for some of the appliances in season 2.
 Lowered the upgrade cost of the second tier of the cutting board in season 1 to 500 coins.
 Lowered the number of coins earned as tips in the first levels of season 1 (was 100% before, which did not make sense).
 Improved chef's movement handling.
 Fixed a bug that sometimes caused the controller to vibrate forever.


I'm working very hard on season 3, but keep getting distracted by brilliant ideas from our awesome gamers that I immediately want to incorporate into the game.

As always - we are open to all suggestions (please no more brilliant ones tho ːsteamhappyː). Reach out to us on the discussion board.

Cook safe!
Lucy & Jan Mysior
Yellow Dot Games

notes.title: Stains, splashes & smudges - Update 0.8.5
notes.notes:
Hello Chefs!
We've had a very busy week. This time around the update is mostly about... stains. We have given them a LOT of love. Dropping food is one of the key "Oh noooo!" mechanics in the game so we are happy with how horrifying/satisfying the experience is now with new graphics, VFX, and sounds. It turned out to be one of the changes that keep putting a grin on our faces every time Lucy and I play LCT.

See our uber-professional stain research made at home:
[previewyoutube=Bj5fn6dfVj4;full][/previewyoutube]

And here is how the new stains work in-game:
[previewyoutube=GiGf4BG12f0;full][/previewyoutube]

Detailed changes:

 NEW: Chef stains. If you drop an ingredient on the floor, the dropped ingredient will first leave a stain on the chef's face or apron. Thanks to Marcin (LCT's awesome graphics designer) for this - it makes the experience so much more complete.
 NEW: Much better floor stains. Before every ingredient dropped on the floor left the same stain, now they all have custom graphics. Since we have over 120 ingredients (in other words things you can carry) in LCT, this required a lot of Lucy's configuration magic. We've also introduced new sounds for these stains.
 NEW: Both above staining mechanisms (chef and floor stains) are now accompanied by one of Kjell's (LCT's awesome VFX designer) stunning VFX.
 NEW: Chef facial reactions. Chefs now react to tossing and catching food and to becoming dirty.
 NEW: You can now reassign controllers manually in the settings menu and in the pause menu. Many thanks to Snicker Furfoot and his thorough review for pointing out the need for that.
 Lucy has increased the coin penalty for dropping the food on the floor. This should make the experience of dropping that Tower Burger even more horri... fun.
 Introduced a tiny threshold for when a chef switches sides while walking left and right. This should reduce the amount of "I didn't want THAT!" situations for some trigger-happy players (like me).
 When walking on a stain the chef's speed is reduced (by an amount based on chosen game difficulty). The stain's speed reduction power will now last longer making the stains more of a problem for food-wasting chefs.
 Flipping two pancakes in quick succession (on a double crepe pan) should now properly trigger the flipping animation.
 Turning on the shake maker right after flipping a pancake should now properly trigger the animation.
 Trying to take out food from an automatic blender (Burger Ring) when it's not done will now cause Leonard to give the appropriate comment.
 A chef that activates the topping machine (Pancake Splash) during food combining animation will now snap to a proper position.
 Appliance sounds are now switched off when entering the pause menu.
 Disconnecting a gamepad during the level summary will no longer cause this UI nightmare:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37145478/fc9de3161f3f59663a8e4b58a3e15ecdacbab822.png
 Smashing buttons during the loading screen should no longer break the game.
 Another set of typos squashed.


Season 3 is in deep in the works and I hope we can ship a very first version of it in about 3 weeks. I plan to provide a sneak peek of its graphics and dishes soon.

As always - we are open to all suggestions - please feel free to reach out to us in the discussion board.

Cook safe!
Lucy & Jan Mysior
Yellow Dot Games

notes.title: Introducing Intro - Update 0.8.4
notes.notes:
Hello Chefs!
Let's Cook Together is not only about the game. It's mainly about spending time with your loved ones. We strongly encourage you all to actually cook together as much as possible. To be a shining example here I am playing the analog version of Let's Cook Together with my kids:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37145478/2ca548cca9ef2260ea7e2d6c22249b964739a032.jpg
[In the picture: our 7-year-old twins Kuba (left) and Adam (right), 4-year-old Mati (in the middle) and me]

List of changes
This week brings quite a few changes to LCT (game):

 We now have a super cool (and short) story intro in our game. You can see it here:
[previewyoutube=wirQReLyUTM;full][/previewyoutube]
 Lucy introduced a ton of level design changes to the Pancake Splash to make it more balanced in terms of left-right player workload and also a little more dynamic during the first weeks in terms of new dishes introduction. We would really like your input on how you feel this restaurant plays out.
 Introduced dynamic vSync to remove tearing in the menu. In short - vSync is turned on in the menu and off during normal gameplay. I'm pretty satisfied with that as it makes the menu effects look super sharp while keeping uncapped framerates for the actual gameplay. Yay! :)
 Cookbook graphics for all muffins now look much better.
 We have tweaked collision detection a bit so that the chefs don't go too much into walls.
 Fixed an error in the Pancake Splash which occurred when there were 1 topping dispenser and 2 levers in the level. The wires should also be colored properly now.
 Slight change in the logic for the shake maker in the Pancake Splash. This was proposed by our QA tester Ania (awesome of course). Instead of making "the switcheroo" of ingredients when approached with full hands, it will first try to give the ingredient to the chef. We felt this ultimately makes more sense in this case. For TL;DR see this short video:
[previewyoutube=i253B4v_IMU;full][/previewyoutube]
 Another set of typos squashed.
 Disconnecting a gamepad during gameplay should now no longer cause issues.
 New dishes in level presentation (the one at the start of many levels) was fixed to show proper dishes.


We are open to all suggestions - please feel free to reach out to us in the discussion board.

Cook safe!
Lucy & Jan Mysior
Yellow Dot Games

notes.title: New spawning & serving system - Update 0.8.3
notes.notes:
Hello Chefs!
After another set of playtesting sessions with my wife (and LCT level designer) Lucy and basic on feedback from our awesome testers, we have done some rather significant changes.
To show you how a social-distancing game-dev work looks like on our end, here is an image of Lucy playtesting while adjusting level designs in Unity:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37145478/bec0299d86e4183b550cad468019829bdc8f78f4.jpg

List of changes

 Complete rework of the order spawning system. Most of the code in there dated back to 2017 (which is when the very first prototype of LCT was created). It was extremely buggy which often resulted in some orders not being spawned at all or failing to disappear after being completed. The order spawning should now be much less buggy.
 You can now keep running while serving an order. As a bonus, if you hold the serve button and run you can change the order to which you will serve the dish. By default if two or more orders require the same dish it will be served to the order the chef is closer too. Take a look at how it looks like in action here:
[previewyoutube=ZSsA85PGPE4;full][/previewyoutube]

 The amount of additional tip granted when getting a combo (serving two dishes to one order in quick succession) is now tied to the restaurant (was constant across the whole game before). Lucy decided to lower the amounts of combo tips in the Pancake Splash dramatically to make its difficulty a little more consistent.
 Removed stars from the level UI. This means the players will now learn their star score during the summary screen at the end of the level. Not an easy decision to make but we feel this will add a little immersion and make the UI clearer at the same time.
 Minor updates in the Pancake Splash level configurations to make the gameplay more dynamic.
 Cornelius was sometimes not able to blend in the Burger Ring at all (jumped to activate the deep frier upon blending start). All chefs should now be fixed in that regard.
 The green ticks that signalize an appliance has finished processing are now more consistent across restaurants and pieces of equipment.
 The top counter of the double oven in the Pancake Splash kitchen was in the wrong position. It is correct now.
 Blender wire in Pancake Splash was in the wrong position. It is correct now.
 Minor typos fixes


We are open to all suggestions - please feel free to reach out to us in the discussion board.

Cook safe!
Lucy & Jan Mysior
Yellow Dot Games

notes.title: Covid-Easter - Update 0.8.2
notes.notes:
Hello Chefs!
Last week Lucy and I were playtesting the Pancake Splash restaurant (Season 2) heavily. 
Here we are "testing" with our youngest son Mathew during social-distancing-Easter:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37145478/c0dc4d22f763f75221dee13212da8a0d6e5ec181.jpg

This resulted in many changes and bugfixes (version 0.8.2):

 Lucy changed a lot of early levels so that the new gameplay mechanisms introduced by Pancake Splash unfold more quickly.
 Episodes of Season 2 should also now be a little harder to 3-star after a solid portion of Lucy's black magic tricks (we were 3-staring each level on the challenge difficulty). Let us know if it's too hard.
 After a long discussion we decided to lower the price to unlock Pancake Splash to 2000 coins (was 5k before) - enjoy!
 Sometimes our chefs would look like crazed cutthroats (see Chad showing off below). This should no longer happen.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37145478/64b86a136f85b3788fec83a51bd447c20989d1e6.png
 Marcin, our awesome graphics designer and animator did a lot of little animation fixes and tweaks.
 I've finally found the time to add a VFX of restaurant/season unlocking made by Kjell, our awesome VFX designer.


Other changes & fixes:

 Ania, our awesome (as you can clearly see everyone from our team is "awesome") QA tester found a lot of typos in the polish localization - these are now fixed.
 When doing the "Fruitcake Woof'L" waffle you can now add banana as the first ingredient (thanks Ania!)
 Drink glass on the automatic version of the Orange Gina Dispenser should now always spawn on the proper layer.
 Chefs should now be more focused when holding the blender button (they used to wave their hands up and down together with the idle animation).
 Gloria's collisions were adjusted - she should now handle a bit more easily in the tight kitchen areas.
 I introduced a fix to combat invisible orders spawning on rare occasions. As this bug is so far impossible to recreate in a test environment I give no promises the fix will work :-)


We are open to all suggestions - please feel free to reach out to us in the discussion board.

Cook safe!
Lucy & Jan Mysior
Yellow Dot Games

notes.title: Let's Cook Together - Update 0.8.1
notes.notes:
Hello Chefs!
I'm Jan and I'm the lead developer of Let's Cook Together (and Them Bombs). In this channel we will be posting info on Let's Cook Together (LCT for short) updates.
Today I've cooked up version 0.8.1 to fix a couple of bugs noticed after playing with Lucy (my beautiful wife, mother of my 3 kids and the level designer of LCT). 
First a riddle - what is wrong in this picture?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37145478/5efd6ef27aa85757102dfee535dad834e43cca45.png

That's right! We had a super-villain oven in the very first level of the Pancake Splash restaurant - it should now no longer be invisible.

Other changes & fixes:
- Lucy introduced a couple of changes to the levels to even out the experience for both Chefs,
- the automatic mixing bowl should no longer cause vibration on your gamepad when working (please note that due to hardware limitations vibration is only supported on selected controllers  e.g. Xbox One Controller),
- after switching restaurants in the menu, the episodes view should now scroll to the proper episode,
- introduced a framerate cap to combat some graphical glitches that surfaced on powerful PCs

Now, back to the kitchen we go to prepare even more tasty updates for you!

We are open to all suggestions - please feel free to reach out to us in the discussion board.

Cook safe!
Lucy & Jan Mysior
Yellow Dot Games
